categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in ASIC design services, silicon intellectual property (IP) development and licensing, and non-recurring engineering (NRE) design services. It offers ASIC product design, manufacturing, testing, and silicon IP components for various applications including networking, multimedia, storage, consumer electronics, and AIoT. The business segments include ASIC and wafer products, design services, and IP licensing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary silicon IP development, ASIC design platforms, and advanced process node support such as 14nm FinFET and 28nm/40nm processes. The company utilizes a comprehensive design flow integrating digital and analog IP, SoC platforms, and verification tools. Production is outsourced to foundries like UMC and Samsung, with in-house testing and quality control. The company also develops embedded flash memory platforms and high-speed interface IPs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are IC design companies and system manufacturers requiring ASIC and silicon IP solutions. Key markets include networking, multimedia, AIoT, industrial control, and green energy sectors. The company serves customers globally, including Taiwan, China, Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the United States, focusing on niche applications with long product lifecycles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with headquarters in Hsinchu Science Park and offices in Taipei and Tainan. It has established overseas R&D centers and sales offices in China, the United States, India, Vietnam, Japan, and Singapore. Its sales and services cover Asia-Pacific, Europe, and North America, supporting a global customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless ASIC design service provider and silicon IP developer. It collaborates closely with upstream foundries for wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing partners. It does not manufacture wafers but manages design, verification, and testing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing silicon IP for key process nodes (14nm FinFET, 22nm, 28nm), expanding SoC platform capabilities, and enhancing system-level integration. The company invests heavily in R&D (~18% of revenue) focusing on automotive-grade IP, embedded flash memory, high-speed interfaces, and AIoT applications. It also emphasizes sustainability, digital transformation, and talent development to support long-term growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through ASIC product sales (mass production), design service fees (NRE), and silicon IP licensing royalties. The business model emphasizes recurring revenue from IP licensing and volume production of ASICs. The company also derives income from technical support and platform development services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading fabless ASIC and silicon IP provider in Taiwan and globally, with a strong foothold in niche ASIC markets and advanced IP development. Competitors include other ASIC design service firms and IP vendors focusing on advanced process nodes and system-level solutions. The company differentiates by its proprietary IP portfolio, comprehensive design platforms, and close foundry partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown strong financial growth with consolidated revenue reaching approximately NT$13 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 62% increase year-over-year. Net profit and EPS have more than doubled, reflecting robust demand and operational efficiency. The company maintains a solid balance sheet with total assets around NT$13.9 billion and equity nearing NT$9.9 billion, demonstrating healthy financial scale and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers unique value through its proprietary silicon IP portfolio, comprehensive SoC design platforms, and verified design flows that reduce integration risk and accelerate time-to-market. Its focus on niche, long lifecycle ASIC applications and system-level IP subsystems provides customers with tailored, high-quality solutions. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, global support network, and commitment to sustainability further differentiate it in the competitive semiconductor design services market.
